title: Choices made in fixing the security review's findings
decision: One mebibyte as the limit for every request body, with uploads to get a larger allowance of their own; five minutes of allowance in the database's check of the 30-day wait for the application server's clock; opening a shop from the chat keeps an API-shaped request key; asking for and cancelling deletion stay allowed in a suspended shop while changes to settings, staff and ownership are refused there
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 45
rationale: The review names the defects and leaves the limits, and whether a suspended shop's owner may still ask for erasure, to be decided
